name: preview-card-1m
title: Preview Card 1m: Spine
author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
description: A catalogue card for showing a live component preview. The name runs vertically along a narrow spine on the left, like the spine of a book.
docs: Every preview card design exports the same `PreviewCard` component, so you can switch designs by changing the import path. Pass the live preview as children.
